audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart disagreed with its own why. whys[0] gives Shen a genuine Level 1 edge but the row said Skill; whys[1] and whys[2] describe an even lane but the rows said Shen; whys[3] calls 4-5 Shen's clearest window but the row said Skill; whys[4] describes Camille's ultimate taking over at 6 but the row said Skill; whys[5] says neither item spike dominates but the row said Shen. Packet levelChart is Shen, Skill, Skill, Shen, Camille, Skill, Shen.
audit.why: Camille has no gap-close at 1, so Shen's blade-pull owns it; Tactical Sweep and Hookshot even it out; Levels 4-5 are Shen's with all three abilities against a single 16s escape; The Hextech Ultimatum at 6 is her window.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Shen; Levels 2-3 Skill; Levels 4-5 Shen; Level 6 Camille; First item Skill; 2+ items Shen. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes cover Lvl 1, Lvls 4-5, Lvl 6 and 2+ items, which is exactly where the corrected chart changes hands.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text rewritten off the false R-denies-R claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors repeated across the entry. (1) The Hextech Ultimatum was said to suppress, cancel or prevent Stand United — Riot's text says she dashes to a champion and anchors them to the area; it applies no silence and no channel interrupt. (2) Tactical Sweep was called a true-damage cone — the trueDamage in Camille's kit is on Precision Protocol (Q); W's outer half does extra damage, slows and heals her.
audit.why: A player told their ultimate is disabled will hold a 200s cooldown for nothing; a player told W is true damage will build the wrong resistances and stand in the outer ring anyway.
audit.corrected: R restated as an anchor that does not stop the cast, with its 140s rank-1 cooldown; W restated as an outer-half heal that Grievous Wounds answers; Precision Protocol named as the true-damage auto reset.

audit.why: Hookshot at 16/15/14/13/12s is the punishable cooldown and the entry already trades on it.

edits.before: She has Tactical Sweep (W) now — do not stand at max outer-ring range where her true-damage cone and heal apply; short trades only.
edits.after: She has Tactical Sweep (W) now — the outer half of the cone deals extra damage and heals her, so never trade at that edge; short trades only.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum isolates Shen and suppresses Stand United — if she has R and you are below 60% HP, she can duel you 1v1 in a cage where you cannot cast R or disengage.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you to her zone for the duel — it does not silence, so Stand United still casts; what it denies is walking out of her 140s cage.

edits.before: Camille's Hextech Ultimatum isolates Shen and removes his R teleport option — if she R's you at 6 you cannot Stand United out, so track her R and pre-cast yours before she closes.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you inside her zone on a 140s rank-1 cooldown — Stand United still casts, so spend it before she lands the anchor rather than fighting her inside it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are Shen's clearest window — you have all three abilities and Camille's Hookshot is still her only real gap-close. Control the wave around your tower so she cannot wall-jump for a free angle, and bait the Hookshot: the moment she commits E, E-taunt her back and deploy W so her auto-attack follow-up is fully blocked. She cannot reset with Q procs if she is taunted and her autos are blanked. At Level 6, respect Hextech Ultimatum — it cancels Stand United mid-channel, trapping you in a 1v1 with a duelist who out-scales. If Camille is at kill range, pre-empt with R on a low ally before she can R you, or save it so it fires the instant her cage drops.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are Shen's clearest window — you have all three abilities and Camille's Hookshot, 16s at rank 1, is still her only real gap-close. Control the wave around your tower so she cannot wall-jump for a free angle, and bait the Hookshot: the moment she commits E, E-taunt her back and deploy W so her auto-attack follow-up is fully blocked. She cannot reset Precision Protocol if she is taunted and her autos are blanked. At Level 6, respect The Hextech Ultimatum — it anchors you inside her zone for a 1v1 with a duelist who out-scales, though it never silences the cast. If Camille is at kill range, pre-empt with R on a low ally before she anchors you.

edits.before: Use E (Shadow Dash) to taunt Camille mid-W animation so her true-damage cone autos land inside your Spirit's Refuge
edits.after: Taunt Camille during Tactical Sweep's delay so her follow-up autos land inside Spirit's Refuge and she heals nothing

edits.before: Land Hookshot (E) onto a wall to gap-close and immediately W for the true-damage heal outside your Spirit's Refuge zone
edits.after: Land Hookshot (E) onto a wall, then catch the outer half of Tactical Sweep for the heal outside your Spirit's Refuge zone

edits.before: Use Hextech Ultimatum (R) to isolate Shen and prevent Stand United from being cast during the duel
edits.after: Use The Hextech Ultimatum (R) to anchor Shen in her zone so the duel is over before help arrives

edits.before: That is Camille's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her — bring Grievous Wounds for long trades.

notes: The kit file flags The Hextech Ultimatum as 'untargetable', but Riot's description of the ability says only that she dashes to a champion and anchors them — no untargetability. Per the kit rules I trusted the description and did NOT write the _missing 'she goes untargetable through your commit' line; listed as unverified. Same conclusion as the camille-side mirror on the R-cancels-Stand-United claim.
